title: Gift of Eggness
body:
Trade-only
This item is no longer available unless by means of trading with another player.

"Don't shake it, it'll crack! Openable after the easter event."

Description

The Gift of Eggness is a limited-time item that used to be purchasable at Eggstatic Hop Shop for 200 Eggs as part of Version 1.5.0 (2023 Easter Event). Once unwrapped, it contains the Eg.

Appearance

The Gift of Eggness is tall compared to the Gift Of Alpha Uncertainty and has a lilac color with red-violet polka dots topped with a white ribbon.

The Eg is an egg with a smily face and two wobbly legs that keeps on wobbling uncontrollably. It's a reference to game called "Eg"
